name: Western Ghats
description: Explore the majestic Sahyadri ranges with lush green valleys, hidden waterfalls, and ancient trails that wind through some of India's most biodiverse landscapes.

name: Coastal Maharashtra
description: Discover pristine Konkan beaches, secret coves, and vibrant coastal villages where the Arabian Sea meets ancient fishing traditions.

name: Hill Stations
description: Retreat to misty hill stations nestled in the Western Ghats, where cool breezes, rolling meadows, and colonial charm create the perfect escape.

name: Heritage & Forts
description: Walk the ramparts of Maratha strongholds perched on dramatic peaks, where every stone tells a story of courage, strategy, and empire.

name: Waterfalls & Monsoon
description: Chase monsoon magic through thundering waterfalls, emerald valleys, and rain-washed trails that come alive only a few months each year.
